title: Rules.
bodyText: The foundation shall adopt rules in consultation with the comptroller for the purposes of administering this chapter. Such rules shall be adopted in accordance with chapter 91.
bodyHtml: [§9-5]  Rules.  The foundation shall adopt rules in consultation with the comptroller for the purposes of administering this chapter.  Such rules shall be adopted in accordance with chapter 91. [L 1977, c 112, pt of §2]
